items.title: Disney Animation Studios Boss Jared Bush Isn't Ruling Out a Possible Kingdom Hearts Movie
items.description: Jared Bush, chief creative officer of Walt Disney Animation Studios, spoke about the possibility of a Kingdom Hearts feature film, and he didn’t rule out the idea.
items.author: Virginia Glaze
items.content:
Jared Bush, chief creative officer of Walt Disney Animation Studios, spoke about the possibility of a Kingdom Hearts feature film, and he didn’t rule out the idea.

Kingdom Hearts fans are on top of the world after footage of the fourth game was shown off at D23. Sora and the gang are back to fight the heartless, which are wreaking havoc in the Land of the Dead. Coco’s universe is an explorable world in Kingdom Hearts IV, and Sora even gets a keyblade themed after Héctor's Guitar, along with some calavera facepaint to match.

A Kingdom Hearts animated series was also announced at the event, coming to Disney+ on an as-yet undetermined date. With these two big reveals in mind, IGN’s Jeffrey Vega quizzed Walt Disney Animation Studios’ Jared Bush if there’s anything more planned for the Kingdom Hearts world on Disney’s side of things… specifically, a feature-length animated film.

“Are we ever gonna get a Kingdom Hearts movie?” Vega asked, going on to joke that Bush basically has the power to “greenlight” the project.

“Technically, you’re not wrong,” Bush answered. “I’d say, I’m always excited to hear what people are passionate about. And I’d say that we have a very bright future of new projects coming out — different ways of putting material out into the world. So I would just say, nothing is impossible.”

Bush’s response was, as expected, quite reserved, but his open-ended answer leaves no end of possibilities to the imagination. Given all the good news fans just got about the franchise, specifically the animated show, the idea of a full-length CGI movie following Sora’s adventures doesn’t seem so impossible now... especially since Disney recently bragged that Kingdom Hearts is one of its "billion-dollar franchises."

Kingdom Hearts IV is scheduled for release in late 2027. Combat footage from Coco’s section of the game seen at D23 shows Sora using the keyblade as a kind of skateboard as he follows a flying heartless, to which he’s tethered by a glowing chain. Graphically, the game looks absolutely stunning, with the endless city of the dead giving an impressive depth to the environment.

This most recent trailer also showed off Mickey, Goofy, and our iconic king of the underworld, Hades, as well as a few glimpses of some story beats that take place in Quadratum, a realistic city inspired by modern-day Tokyo — an area that was also shown in the game's surprise trailer at the June 2026 Nintendo Direct.

This isn’t the last we’ll see of Kingdom Hearts IV this weekend; the game will also be discussed on August 15 in a panel titled ‘DEEP DIVE into KINGDOM HEARTS at D23,’ streaming at 4.30pm PT / 7.30pm ET / August 16 at 12.30 AM UK time. Disney has confirmed that it will feature a “behind-the-scenes look at the making of the games,” with names like Nana Gadd from Disney & Pixar Games, Tai Yasue from Square Enix, Haley Joel Osment, the voice of Sora, David Gallagher, the voice of Riku, and Renée Johnson, who voices some of the Disney-specific characters.

In the meantime, keep it locked to IGN for more news coming out of D23 this weekend, and check out everything that got announced at the event’s big presentation at the Honda Center on August 14.

items.title: First Trailer for Star Wars: Starfighter Shown at D23 — Here's What We Saw
items.description: Lucasfilm has shown off the debut trailer for Star Wars: Starfighter at the Disney fan event, D23.
items.author: Wesley Yin-Poole
items.content:
Lucasfilm has shown off the debut trailer for Star Wars: Starfighter at the Disney fan event, D23.

The brief first look at the upcoming movie shows Ryan Gosling’s pilot character, now confirmed to be called Kade Auberon, discover a child playing with his decommissioned starfighter inside a garage. There's a reason it was decommissioned, Kade says. We then see Kade fly across a number of otherworldly landscapes, and in classic Star Wars fashion, droids shoot at the ship as Kade’s droid helps him escape.

On stage at D23, director Shawn Levy handed Gosling a new jacket to wear. On the back is the symbol of his character, Kade Auberon, which you can see below.

Starfighter is a standalone Star Wars movie that is neither a prequel nor a sequel, director Shawn Levy has insisted. "It’s a new adventure," he said of the post-Rise of Skywalker film at Star Wars Celebration 2025. "It’s set in a period of time that we haven’t seen explored yet." As part of that, it will not feature any "legacy characters," so don't expect to see Rey Skywalker pop up.

Ryan Gosling stars alongside Amy Adams, Aaron Pierre, Matt Smith, Mia Goth, and Flynn Gray. Star Wars: Starfighter is currently due to launch on May 28, 2027. Catch up on everything announced at D23 2026 right here.

Photo by Jesse Grant/Getty Images for Disney.

items.title: X-Men Cast Confirmed to Include Inde Navarette as Rogue, Adam Driver as Mister Sinister, Maya Boyd as Storm, and More | D23 2026
items.description: Marvel Studios has confirmed a long list of names for its new MCU X-Men movie reboot, with its cast now including Inde Navarrette, Adam Driver, Maya Boyd, and more.
items.author: Michael Cripe
items.content:
Marvel Studios has confirmed a long list of names for its new MCU X-Men movie reboot, with its cast now including Inde Navarrette as Rogue, Adam Driver as Mister Sinister, Maya Boyd as Storm, and more.

The comic book movie company confirmed just a portion of the cast at D23 2026. Some of the actors in attendance – such as Kit Connor as Cyclops and Samara Weaving as Emma Frost – were previously announced, but we'll share the full lineup below.

Inde Navarrette – Rogue

Adam Driver – Mister Sinister

Maya Boyd – Storm

Christopher Abbott – Professor X

Sadie Sink – Jean Grey

Kit Connor – Cyclops

Samara Weaving – Emma Frost

There is a lot to unpack here. First off, those rumors that Alien alum Cailee Spaeny would be playing Rogue have been thoroughly debunked, as Obsession breakout Navarette will be using her power-absorbing abilities in the MCU instead. It may not be the Mystique casting she had hoped for, but she's probably still pretty happy to be on the team.

Driver, meanwhile, has been rumored to be circling a few roles, including the Master of Magnetism himself, Magneto. While some had correctly predicted the Star Wars veteran's role, he's now confirmed to be playing X-Men villain and evil mastermind Mister Sinister.

Navarrette and Driver have garnered quite the reputation on the big screen, Boyd's film resume doesn't seem to be quite as extensive. Her part harnessing the power of Mother Nature as Storm will see her take her biggest part yet, with past projects including 2023 short Deadbeat, as well as some work on Broadway.

Rogue, Mister Sinister, and Storm were the big surprises, but not to be outdone was the announcement that Abbott will lead as X-Men mentor Professor Charles Xavier. The Hollywood Reported had reported that he was in the running to play the mind-reading telepath recently, with his presence at D23 confirming his spot on the team of mutants. Movie fans will recognize him from his parts in projects like Poor Things, Possessor, and It Comes at Night.

Connor and Weaving had been announced in the weeks leading up to tonight's D23 event, so it wasn't much of a surprise to see them take the stage alongside X-Men movie director and Thunderbolts* filmmaker Jake Schreier. Sink is a more interesting case, as those who have [SPOILERS FOR RECENT MCU MOVIES] seen box-office smash Spider-Man: Brand New Day will know that she actually already made her on-screen debut as Jean Grey alongside Spidey star Tom Holland.

Without counting some of the many, many other rumors that have circulated before today, this is our first official look at the X-Men cast. Marvel still has plenty of mutants to pull into the live-action world, though, so while seven confirmed actors feels like a lot, we'll surely only learn about more in the months ahead.

The X-Men are coming to the MCU:

Sadie Sink is Jean Grey
Kit Connor is Cyclops
Christopher Abbott is Professor Charles Xavier
Samara Weaving is Emma Frost
Inde Navarrette is Rogue
Maya Boyd is Storm
Adam Driver is Nathaniel Milbury

Only in theaters May 5, 2028. pic.twitter.com/ZCd4f7I1W7

— Marvel Studios (@MarvelStudios) August 15, 2026

Marvel Studios also took the D23 showcase as an opportunity to confirm its MCU X-Men movie has a release date: May 5, 2028. That makes it the third film officially confirmed for that year, joining Black Panther 3 (December 15) and Ghost Rider (2028). For more, you can read about everything else Disney had to announce at tonights D23 showcase.

Photo by Jesse Grant/Getty Images for Disney.

items.title: New Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Shows Doctor Doom Raising an Army of Sentinels
items.description: Marvel Studios has released a new Avengers: Doomsday trailer, showing off Doctor Doom’s true power and his army of Sentinels.
items.author: Wesley Yin-Poole
items.content:
Marvel Studios has released a new Avengers: Doomsday trailer, showing off Doctor Doom’s true power and his army of Sentinels.

The trailer offers a bleak outlook for our heroes, with a tearful Sue Storm bemoaning what Victor has become. Doom, played by Iron Man actor Robert Downey Jr., is clearly out for revenge after what appears to have been the death of his wife and son (or his mother).

Everyone's looking pretty worried about what's happening. We see a battered and bruised Magneto, Gambit, Steve Rogers, and others all with furrowed brows. Doom, Sue states, is "broken."

We then see a destroyed city, with Reed Richards telling Doom he can't believe what he's done. "Victor, did you do this?" Reed asks. "All of you have lived stolen lives," Doom says. "But now you must give them back." Doom leaps out of a window and crashes to the ground below, displaying an immense power of movement. "Answer me Victor, did you do this?!" Reed screams. Thor tries to stop Doom but he is swatted away with ease. Undeterred, Doom raises an army of Sentinels, declaring: "Hell answers to me, for I am Doom."

During's Marvel's segment of Disney's panel at its fan event, D23, Wolverine actor Hugh Jackman appeared on-screen to riff with an off-screen Deadpool's Ryan Reynolds. Jackman asked to join the cast of Avengers: Doomsday, but it's unclear if this is just a joke or if the due are actually in the movie.

Also at D23, we got our first look at Nightcrawler and Mystique's costumes for Avengers: Doomsday, as well as a new poster showing Doctor Doom.

Earlier this month, former Captain America actor Chris Evans said Avengers: Doomsday will be "brutal" for Steve Rogers. Marvel's upcoming blockbuster will see Rogers return to the MCU for the first time in seven years, with Evans once again reunited with the Russo brothers, who previously directed him in Captain America: The Winter Soldier, Captain America: Civil War, Avengers: Infinity War, and Avengers: Endgame.

Steve Rogers was certainly put through the wringer during those films, though his story seemingly gained a happy ending — back in time with his beloved Peggy Carter. Alas, this happy ending now looks likely to be undone.

"The Russos love beating up Steve Rogers," Evans said during an appearance at Boston Fan Expo. "Their favorite thing to do is to just beat the crap out of him. To them that's what makes a hero, and that's someone who gets punched so many times but still gets up.

"They keep finding new ways to kick his butt, but this one was brutal," Evans teased, "and a really, really good examination into his nature and his values. I'll say... it's probably something you haven't seen yet, but you will."

What could be the cause of this fresh heartbreak for Steve Rogers? Well, with the character now revealed to be a father, fans are fearful that something horrible will happen to his child. After all, Doom appears to have an interest in the children of superheroes — we last saw him holding baby Franklin in The Fantastic Four: First Steps' post-credits scene. Children also feature heavily in this latest Avengers: Doomsday trailer.

Would Marvel go so dark as to kill Steve Rogers' child? It sounds unlikely, but there's still a lot we don't know about Avengers: Doomsday's plot. The film's trailers have previously shown two very different looks for Steve Rogers, enough that some fans think the character will appear via two alter egos. But it could just be that we see a slightly aged-up, bearded version of Steve — meaning his child is now older, too.

Whatever's in store, it was clearly interesting enough for Chris Evans to agreed to return after "at least a dozen pitches" for other MCU projects. While we wait for Avengers: Doomsday to premiere on December 18, you can read about the secret message Robert Downey Jr. hid while at San Diego Comic-Con and see how Feige fought back against criticism of Doctor Doom's lack of build-up.

Catch up on everything announced at D23 2026 right here.

items.title: Disney's Live-Action Tangled Remake Sets 2028 Release Date | D23 2026
items.description: Disney has confirmed its live-action Tangled remake now has a 2028 release date.
items.author: Michael Cripe
items.content:
Disney has confirmed its live-action Tangled remake now has a 2028 release date.

The latest in its long line of real-life reimaginings was scheduled to premiere March 31, 2028, during the company's D23 2026 presentation today. The announcement came with a first look at the film from the cast, which includes Teagan Croft as Rapunzel, Milo Manheim as Flynn Rider, and Kathryn Hahn as Mother Gothel.

The update for Disney's movie calendar won't see the film swing in for another year and a half. Other details for how it will change from the 2010 original Tangled remain to be revealed.

Here's the first look at Kathryn Hahn as Mother Gothel in the live-action Tangled remake. #D23 pic.twitter.com/hoXrCajxcC

— IGN (@IGN) August 15, 2026

Disney has been building toward the release of its Tangled remake for quite some time. However, it wasn't until the success of its live-action Lilo & Stitch movie that the ball really got rolling.

Croft and Manheim boarding as its stars this past January. Following months of fan-casts, the same month also brought the reveal that Kathryn Hahn was in talks to play the villainous Mother Gothel, with her role in the film confirmed in March.

D23 attendees got a first official look at the Tangled cast in costume tonight, but it wasn't the first time fans have seen footage from Disney's shoot in Spain. Last month, behind-the-scenes shots of live-action Rapunzel and Flynn Rider started to leak out onto the internet. Some images also revealed sneak peeks at Patrick and Hugo McPherson as the remake's take on the Stabbington brothers.

Tangled is now set to come down from its tower March 31, 2028. There's still some time to go before that happens, though, giving Disney lots of time to prepare for a premiere that will hopefully fare better than its live-action Moana outing. For more on Disney's big-screen endeavors, you can catch up on everything announced at the D23 2026 showcase.

Croft and Manheim boarding as its stars this past January. Following months of fan-casts, the same month also brought the reveal that Kathryn Hahn was in talks to play the villainous Mother Gothel, with her role in the film confirmed in March.

D23 attendees got a first official look at the Tangled cast in costume tonight, but it wasn't the first time fans have seen footage from Disney's shoot in Spain. items.title: Kingdom Hearts 4 Gets New Trailer, Late 2027 Release Window, and a Disney+ Anime Series
items.description: Big Kingdom Hearts news here at D23, with a new trailer for Kingdom Hearts 4, a late 2027 release window, and — surprise! — a Disney+ series.
items.author: Wesley Yin-Poole
items.content:
Big Kingdom Hearts news here at D23, with a new trailer for Kingdom Hearts 4, a late 2027 release window, and — surprise! — a Disney+ anime series.

The new trailer shows the addition of Pixar's Coco. Also at D23, Disney set a November 2029 release for Coco 2.

As for the Kingdom Hearts Disney+ anime, it's developed with creator Tetsuya Nomura and Square Enix, and reimagines the video game franchise with a brand-new story "that will expand on the universe of Kingdom Hearts while celebrating the characters that have captured the hearts of millions of fans around the world."

“Kingdom Hearts has captivated gamers everywhere with its unique blend of adventure and imagination,” said Ayo Davis, president, Disney Kids & Family. “There’s something really exciting about taking a world fans have spent years exploring through the games and bringing it to life in a completely new way. And with a creative team that is working closely with the legendary Tetsuya Nomura, our new series will be unmistakably Kingdom Hearts, while giving fans a whole new way to experience the world they love.”

Tonight's news comes ahead of tomorrow's Kingdom Hearts panel at D23, where Disney is expected to talk about Kingdom Hearts 4. The livestream of the ‘DEEP DIVE into KINGDOM HEARTS panel at D23’ will be available on August 15 at 4.30pm PT / 7.30pm ET / August 16 at 12.30am UK time. Disney said it will offer a “behind-the-scenes look at the making of the games,” but it’s who’s on the panel that has fans excited for what is now expected news on Kingdom Hearts 4.

The panel guests are Nana Gadd from Disney & Pixar Games, Tai Yasue from Square Enix, Haley Joel Osment, who voices Sora, David Gallagher, who voices Riku, and Renée Johnson, who is behind the Disney character voices. With a panel like that (Yasue is believed to be co-director of Kingdom Hearts 4), you’d like to think we’ll get something on the hotly anticipated sequel.

Kingdom Hearts 4 made a surprise appearance at the June 2026 Nintendo Direct to reveal a first look at gameplay years after the game itself was announced. In a separate post, Square Enix confirmed that Kingdom Hearts 4 will launch simultaneously for PC via Epic Games Store and Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X and S, as well as Nintendo Switch 2.

"A new installment in the action role-playing series developed and published by Square Enix, Kingdom Hearts 4 gives fans a look at some of the characters that protagonist Sora will meet in the mysterious city of Quadratum," an official description for the game said. "Sora will once again journey to realms, where new figures cross his path and new powers awaken his next chapter. Kingdom Hearts 4 will be available at launch on Nintendo Switch 2."

Catch up on everything announced at D23 2026 right here.

items.title: The Princess Diaries 3 Is Taking So Long Because Disney Is 'Working So Hard to Get It Right,' Anne Hathaway Says | D23 2026
items.description: Anne Hathaway took the stage at D23 to confirm that work on The Princess Diaries 3 is moving steadily ahead.
items.author: Michael Cripe
items.content:
Anne Hathaway took the stage at D23 2026 to confirm that work on The Princess Diaries 3 is moving steadily ahead.

The Princess of Genovia herself confirmed the news during this year's show. Progress is slow going for now, but it sounds like she and the rest of the team behind the long-awaited sequel have a good reason for making fans wait.

"Being part of the Disney family also means being part of a legacy studio that deeply values the family audience it makes content for," Hathaway said. "It’s why we are working so hard to get The Princess Diaries 3 right. Thanks for your patience."

It's been 22 years since The Princess Diaries 2: Royal Engagement came to theaters. That means the wait for more has been especially brutal, though it's not been without its updates.

Hathaway previously confirmed plans to return to Genovia as Queen Mia Thermopolis back in 2024. While the late Garry Marshall was responsible for directing the first two films, The Hollywood Reporter reported that Crazy Rich Asians' Adele Lim had stepped in to direct the upcoming third film.

Author Meg Cabot told the site earlier this summer that she had already read a script for The Princess Diaries 3. It's unclear just how far along it is, but it's at least something she's happy with so far.

"I read a script, and it was amazing," Cabot said. "I told them not to send anymore, because I love it so much. They don’t like it when you tell people what’s gonna happen yet. So I was like, 'Better not send me any more scripts!'"

Julie Andrews, meanwhile, confirmed just earlier this week that she has no plans to return for the new movie. It's unclear how the third film may handle her absence.

"I think the absolute truth is that I think I’m really past all that now," she told The Hollywood Reporter. “I’m not completely retired, but it’s a different kind of work that I do these days — [writing] books, and I do a lot of recording of podcasts and voiceovers. But truly, I don’t think I should be a part of it."

While we wait to hear more about Hathaway's involvement in The Princess Diaries 3, you can read IGN's reviews for two of her recent films: The Odyssey and The End of Oak Street. You can also catch up on all of the other big D23 announcements from tonight's event here.

items.title: Star Wars Disney+ Series Ahsoka Season 2 Finally Has a Release Date
items.description: Ahsoka Season 2 premieres January 20, 2027 on Disney+.
items.author: Wesley Yin-Poole
items.content:
Ahsoka Season 2 premieres January 20, 2027 on Disney+.

Confirmation of the release date has emerged from Disney fan event D23, where IGN is reporting live with all the announcements. The debut trailer for Season 2 is below.

Season 2 arrives three-and-a-half years after Ahsoka's first episodes aired back in August 2023. Rosario Dawson reprises her title role, with Season 2 continuing the story of the infamous Jedi and her friends as they counter an invasion by the villainous Grand Admiral Thrawn and investigate a mysterious neighbouring galaxy.

The threat of Thrawn had been intended as a focus in the now-scrapped The Mandalorian Season 4, so it's intriguing to wonder how plans for Ahsoka may have shifted after Lucasfilm decided to make The Mandalorian and Grogu for the big screen instead. Was more of the Thrawn storyline shifted back into Ahsoka?

Season 2 will also see the return of Hayden Christensen in further scenes as Anakin Skywalker, following his Season 1 guest appearance via Star Wars' extradimensional plane, The World Between Worlds. With more Anakin, and more of The World Between Worlds, fans are wondering how Ahsoka might introduce new kinds of storytelling opportunities in future for the franchise.

Disney has scaled back its live-action Star Wars show production over the past couple of years, following a splurge on limited series such as Obi-Wan Kenobi and The Book of Boba Fett, both of which landed to mixed reviews. Neither Skeleton Crew nor The Acolyte made much of an impression either, with no second season planned for either series.

Ahsoka Season 2 will also see Game of Thrones actor Rory McCann take on the role of Baylan Skoll, following the death of Ray Stevenson. Returning cast members include Natasha Liu Bordizzo as Sabine Wren, Mary Elizabeth Winstead as Hera Syndulla, Ivanna Sakhno as Shin Hati, Eman Esfandi as Ezra Bridger, and Lars Mikkelsen as Thrawn.

items.title: The Simpsons: Hit & Run 'Coming Back in Some Form,' Creator Matt Groening Says
items.description: The Simpsons: Hit & Run 'is coming back in some form,' according to series creator Matt Groening.
items.author: Michael Cripe
items.content:
The Simpsons: Hit & Run "is coming back in some form," according to series creator Matt Groening.

Yes, at least as far as the mind behind Springfield and the Simpson family is concerned, Vivendi Games and Radical Entertainment's classic 2000s video game spinoff will finally soon let players get behind the wheel again. He shared his comments during a The Simpsons panel at Disney fan event D23 2026, but it sounds like, maybe, he should have pumped the brakes when it came to any announcements for The Simpsons: Hit & Run.

"I think the original game is coming back in some form," Groening said (via Empire).

Just as Groening let it slip that the Grand Theft Auto-inspired game was coming back, current series showrunner Matt Selman stepped in, saying, "…or not." Whoops.

So, is this a premature announcement, or does Groening have it all wrong? It's difficult to say for now, but when the creator of the franchise the game is based on says The Simpsons: Hit & Run is making some sort of return, it's hard not to raise an eyebrow.

The internet felt the same, as social media feeds quickly filled up with joy as it seemed a 23-year drought without the game could soon come to an end. Groening's mentioning of "the original game" suggests players might want to expect something more like a remaster or remake and not a sequel or reboot. It's hard to know exactly what's coming without something a little more concrete, sadly, so until a more official announcement arrives, it's probably best to keep expectations in check.

What a classic! Hopefully it's a remake/remaster for next gen! pic.twitter.com/zZPAWVhNTv

— Andre Saint-Albin (@AndreSaintAlbin) August 14, 2026

The Simpsons: Hit & Run originally launched for the GameCube, PlayStation 2, and original Xbox in 2003, and all these years later, it remains not only as one of the standout games of the generation but one of the more memorable licensed games of all time. With Springfield re-imagined without losing the show's iconic style, GTA-like gameplay, and the series' iconic sense of humor, it's easy to see why fans have clamored to see it return for all these years.

IGN gave the game an 8.1/10 review. We said at the time that, while it's not a perfect game overall, it's still "undeniably the perfect game for Simpsons fans."

Some of the original The Simpsons: Hit & Run developers said they were shocked it had never made a comeback during an interview with MinnMax in 2023. The years have gone by with few updates, but in March of this year, Selman teased that fans should "never say never."

For now, unfortunately, a The Simpsons: Hit & Run remaster/remake has not been officially announced. Until there is hopefully more to share, you can read about how the rebirth of Radical Entertainment got fans excited earlier this year.

items.title: Disney D23 2026 Entertainment Showcase: Everything Announced
items.description: Check out our coverage of the Disney D23 2026 Entertainment Showcase. We break down every announcement, trailer, and exclusive from Marvel, Star Wars, Pixar, and more.
items.author: Michael Peyton
items.content:
D23: Disney's ultimate fan celebration is back. IGN is on the ground all weekend bringing you the biggest news, exclusive content, deep dives and more. Tonight, the show kicks off with the Disney Entertainment showcase. The presentation will feature reveals from the next two years of Disney's theatrical and streaming slate. That potentially means news about X-Men, Star Wars, Frozen 3, and more.

More from Disney's D23 2026 Entertainment Showcase

  • First Trailer for Star Wars: Starfighter Shown at D23 — Here's What We Saw
  • X-Men Cast Confirmed to Include Inde Navarette as Rogue, Adam Driver as Mister Sinister, Maya Boyd as Storm, and More
  • New Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Shows Doctor Doom Raising an Army of Sentinels
  • Marvel Studios Reveal Debut VisionQuest Trailer, James Spader's Ultron Shown in Human Form
  • Disney's Live-Action Tangled Remake Sets 2028 Release Date
  • Kingdom Hearts 4 Gets New Trailer, Late 2027 Release Window, and a Disney+ Anime Series
  • The Princess Diaries 3 Is Taking So Long Because Disney Is 'Working So Hard to Get It Right,' Anne Hathaway Says

D23 has already seen a new trailer for Disney+'s LEGO Mandarlorian animated special, a look at a new Avatar ride at Disney's California Adventure, a first look at Mystique and Nigthcrawler's costumes from Avengers: Doomsday, and more.

Follow along starting at 7pm PT / 10pm ET for all of the latest updates from what's sure to be a massive showcase.

That's a wrap!

As fake snow falls in the Honda Center, Disney's D23 Entertainment Showcase comes to an end. We saw a ton of news, exciting announcements, and reveals like Adam Driver playing Mr. Sinister in the new X-Men movie, a new look at Avengers: Doomsday, a release date for the Tangled live-action movie, and the first look at Frozen 3. Thanks for joining us.

Frozen 3: Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel reveal a look at the new movie.

The stars of the Frozen franchise are here now to promote Frozen 3, coming Fall 2027. Idina Menzel (Elsa) and Kristen Bell (Anna) started off the segment singing before production difficulties scuttled the act.

“The world of Frozen 3 is a bit different," they say. "Maybe more mysterious. It is great to be back in Arendelle. Anna and Elsa are going on their biggest journey yet. Anna is going on her honeymoon. She’s finally getting hitched to her mountain man Kristoff. Love is in the air for everyone. Even Olaf!"

Josh Gad (Olaf) is now joining them on stage for a song-and-dance routine. It looks like Olaf might have a love interest in the new movie: a girl snowman (snow-woman?) named Samantha.

Now we're getting a sneak peek at Frozen 3.

In the clip, we see the Northern lights. A snowflake falls from the sky, which is cloudless. It becomes a butterfly that flies through the town. Elsa picks it up after turning it into a crystal. She’s wearing a beautiful gown. Anna, Kristoff, and crew show up. “Is our wedding being crashed?” They run onto the lake which has opened up a portal into an ice world. The crystal breaks and turns iinto a butterfly again. It flies up a hill where a purple swarm of butterflies are surrounding a lady. “Look what the northern lights dragged in," says the woman - who seems to possess ice powers like Elsa.

Hailee Steinfeld and Walton Goggins show off Hexed

Hailee Steinfeld and Walton Goggins, stars of the new animated film Hexed, are on stage now. Steinfeld plays Billie, a character who discovers she's a witch but has no knowledge of magic.

“If there’s one thing Disney is known for it’s bringing the magic," Steinfeld says. "In Hexed, we are bringing the witches. Billie discovers she’s a witch and she has no idea of the magic that’s inside. She’s thrust into a magical realm called Hexed, which freaks out her overprotective mother who tries to follow her. Hexed turns out to be a bit more dangerous than you’d expect."

Goggins, in turn, is playing a witch’s favorite companion, a green, three-eyed cat.

Next, we get a sneak peek of Hexed, which also stars Jodie Foster as the Witch Queen, coming to theaters this November.

Clay - New Disney animated film - announced.

"What if the next Disney mentor stunk?’ Bush says. "And he does. His name is Flip, and he’s chosen to be his village’s next great mentor. His student is a literal ball of clay born that very moment named Mushi (Japanese for insect!). Mushi is a being of chaos, Flip has to keep him alive. Kieran Culkin plays Flip."

Clay is slated for a November 2028 release.

Zootopia 3 confirmed.

Zootopia 3 is officially in the works, it was announced at Disney's #D23 Entertainment panel. pic.twitter.com/Xcqp8JiJhz

— IGN (@IGN) August 15, 2026

Jared Bush, the Chief Creative Officer of Walt Disney Animation Studios is on stage now. He says that Zootopia 3, the sequel to one of 2025's biggest movies and Disney's most successful animated movie ever, is a go.

"You can expect to see all the characters you loved in the first 2 films as Zoopia goes to the birds with some feathery fliers," Bush says.

Ryan Gosling's Star Wars: Starfighter character revealed.

Ryan Gosling is now on stage along with Star Wars: Starfighter director Shawn Levy to talk about their new movie, which comes out May 2027 (50 years to the weekend of the debut of the original Star Wars).

Levy says "the story takes place in a period of time that’s never been shown in Star Wars thus far."

"I owe a lot to Disney," Gosling says. "Had they not looked far and wide and come to my hometown I would not be here today. I’m now here 30 years later and I’m back and it’s changing my life again.”

Levy and Gosling go on to confirm the name of Gosling's character in the movie: Cade Oberon.

"Cade is a guy form the wrong side of the galaxy whose fate is intertwined with the fastest star fighter ever built," the duo says.

Next we get a first look at the movie'. We see a young kid open up a garage with a decomissioned ship. Cade (Gosling) says there’s a reason it was decommissioned. Then we cut do a montage of big Star Wars action: lasers blasting at the ship and a droid and two people jumping across a chasm.

Lucasfilm has shown off the debut trailer for Star Wars: Starfighter at the Disney fan event. https://t.co/dhRCgAXXMq#D23 pic.twitter.com/1CYYYvA88l

— IGN (@IGN) August 15, 2026

Hayden Christiansen and Rosario Dawson give us a look at Ahsoka Season 2

Star Wars time! Rosario Dawson, Hayden Christiansen, and Eman Esfandi are here to tease the next season of Ahsoka.

"It’s always an honor to get to play Anakin," Christiansen says. "And in this season he continues to advise Ahsoka. He challenges her and pushes her to answer the toughest question of her life.

"Ezra is back," Esfandi says. "He's home and he’s reunited with his Rebel family. He is fighting for the New Republic against the Imperial remnant.'

Ahsoka Season 2 streams this January on Disney+.

Full X-Men cast revealed!

At #D23 today, Marvel Studios confirmed a long list of names for its new MCU X-Men movie reboot, with its cast now including Inde Navarrette, Adam Driver, Maya Boyd, and more. https://t.co/ztlRAkD63g pic.twitter.com/NzDKKTSBEl

— IGN (@IGN) August 15, 2026

If a new look at Avengers: Doomsday wasn't enough, Sadie Sink is onstage for quite possibly the biggest reveal of the night. She's joined on the stage by Jake Schreier, who looks to be directing the new X-Men movie.

“We will follow [Jean Grey's] story into an all new version of the saga coming to hteaters on May 5 2028!”

We're getting HUGE news about the cast. Sink and Schreier just revealed some major updates in addition to some of the previosuly-revealed cast.

Kit Connor; Cyclops

Professor Charles Xavier: Chrisopher Abbott

Storm: Maya Boyd
Samara Weaving: Emma Frost
Rogue: Inde Navarette

Attendees are seated in the Honda Center and the show is about to begin. So far, the crowd has been treated to some freebies and a few cosplayers on stage to get everyone excited.

items.title: Toy Story 3 Will Be Delisted on Xbox Just Weeks Before Launch of New Remaster
items.description: The original Toy Story 3 video game will soon be delisted from the digital Xbox store ahead of the launch of its new remaster in October.
items.author: Michael Cripe
items.content:
The original Toy Story 3 video game will soon be delisted from the digital Xbox store ahead of the launch of its new remaster in October.

The store page for 2010's unlikely classic has recently been updated with messaging confirming it will be pulled starting September 29, 2026, as shared by TrueAchievements. It means the Pixar video game will no longer be available for purchase at its $9.99 price tag on Xbox One and Xbox Series X | S after that date, though those who already own the game will still be able to play it.

You can probably guess why Toy Story 3 is being delisted; a remaster is right around the corner. Come October 15, a little more than two weeks after the original is delisted, Atari and Digital Eclipse will release Toy Story 3: Complete Edition.

The remaster is said to bring the Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3-era title to modern platforms with upgraded graphics, resolution, and framerate, as well as some previously exclusive content. Judging by the fact that the delisting disclaimer also mentions the Complete Edition, it looks like Disney already wants players to turn their attention to the future.

"Starting on September 29, 2026, Toy Story 3 will no longer be available for purchase. Players who have purchased Toy Story 3 will still be able to access the game after this date," the full announcement on the Xbox store page said. "Toy Story 3: The Complete Edition, will be released on October 15th, 2026 on Xbox Series X|S, and will include all of the features in the original game with updated graphics and additional new features."

The original Toy Story 3 game was developed by Avalanche Software and published by Disney Interactive Studios, with Disney, Atari, and Digital Eclipse announcing their Complete Edition remaster earlier this year. It was revealed with a collection of other soon-to-be-re-released Toy Story games as part of what is being called Toy Story: Retro Roundup.

Both games will arrive for PC, Nintendo Switch, Switch 2, PS4, PS5, and Xbox Series X | S come October 15. Pricing will vary between physical and digital editions, as well as your platform of choice.

A physical two-pack bundle, which comes with both the Complete Edition and Retro Roundup, is listed at $39.99 for the original Switch and PlayStation platforms, while a physical copy for Switch 2 is more expensive at $49.99. The Nintendo eShop, meanwhile, lists the standalone Toy Story 3 remaster for $19.99 for either Switch console. Regardless, you'll be spending extra cash on those new bells and whistles if you want to play Toy Story 3 after the September cutoff.

"Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3," an official description said. "Now available for modern systems, the updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode."

Toy Story 3 is highly regarded, at least as far as movie tie-in games go. IGN gave it a 7.5/10 review in 2010, calling it "an example of when a license game is done mostly right."

items.title: First Look at James Spader as Ultron in VisionQuest Shown at D23
items.description: Marvel gave fans a first look at James Spader as Ultron in VisionQuest, as well as a few other tidbits in a special teaser spotted on the Anaheim Convention Center floor at D23.
items.author: Virginia Glaze
items.content:
Marvel gave fans a first look at James Spader as Ultron in the upcoming Disney+ series VisionQuest, as well as a few other tidbits in a special teaser for the show spotted on the Anaheim Convention Center floor at D23.

Eagle-eyed fans noticed a TV screen framed like a painting among Marvel’s various exhibits at the event, which IGN's on-site reporters confirmed. The artwork shows what appears to be Jim Hammond, the original Human Torch, engulfed in flames.

However, the screen glitches in and out, showing glimpses of Ultron as we remember him from 2015’s Avengers: Age of Ultron and his actor, James Spader.

This has already sparked a debate among fans, with many under the impression that we’ll be seeing a “human” side to the character in the highly-anticipated conclusion of the WandaVision trilogy. Or, even more intriguing, there’s a possibility we could see him take on a human form, rather than the robotic version we’ve become accustomed to over the years.

An image of White Vision, portrayed by Paul Bettany, also flashes onto the screen, who holds up an edition of a Vision Today newspaper. While it’s difficult to make out, the headline discusses “weather warnings… for the third time this year,” as well as what seems to be a secondary headline for a news story about a “jewel thief” continuing a string of supposed crimes.

The Human Torch we see in the painting was first spotted in the MCU as an easter egg in Captain America: The First Avenger. Nicknamed ‘Synthetic Man’ in the film, Jim Hammond was part of the original Avengers alongside Captain America, Bucky Barnes, and Namor.

Ultron was seemingly destroyed by Vision in Age of Ultron, but VisionQuest creator Terry Matalas confirmed the villain would make a comeback for the highly-anticipated TV series.

“We’ve been shooting a Marvel show based on the character of Vision, played by Paul Bettany, one of the great Avengers… It’s very much a show about the Marvel AIs. So we have Paul Bettany, and James Spader is returning as Ultron in a really amazing, unique way,” Matalas said during a panel at STLV: Trek To Vegas in early August.

Matalas spoke at length about what fans can expect from the show at New York Comic Con in October 2025, describing the series as “a delivery system for Bettany and Spader.”

“You do get to see robot Ultron, but you see a lot of James Spader and a lot of Paul Bettany together. They are very much a core dynamic of the show,” he explained. “It’s about a man going through an identity crisis.”

VisionQuest is scheduled to release on October 14, 2026. For more information about Marvel’s upcoming slate of content, including what’s next for Marvel's X-Men movie, keep it locked to IGN, or take a look at some of our interviews with the cast of Avengers: Doomsday from San Diego Comic Con this year.

items.title: First Look at Nightcrawler and Mystique's Costumes for Avengers: Doomsday Shown at D23
items.description: Avengers: Doomsday Costumes for Nightcrawler and Mystique have been shown on the Anaheim Convention Center floor at D23, giving fans their first up-close and personal look at the characters as they will appear in the film.
items.author: Virginia Glaze
items.content:
Avengers: Doomsday Costumes for Nightcrawler and Mystique have been shown on the Anaheim Convention Center floor at D23, giving fans their first up-close and personal look at the characters as they will appear in the film.

D23 is underway, with news about Avengers: Doomsday (and possibly the upcoming X-Men movie) expected to be shared throughout the weekend. Several exhibits of props and costumes for the newest Avengers flick have been displayed for attendees, including outfits for Dr. Doom, Mystique, Nightcrawler, and more.

As shared by IGN’s reporters on the convention center floor, the massive head of a fallen Sentinel was exhibited atop a pile of rubble next to an X-Men logo. Its design is extremely accurate to the comics, boasting glowing green eyes and a purple helmet. Also spotted in the rubble was a sign for Xavier’s School for Gifted Youngsters, which included the address of the X-Mansion: 1407 Graymalkin Lane in Salem Center, Westchester County, New York.

Costumes for X-Men members Nightcrawler and Mystique were also on display. As seen in official posters and trailers for Avengers: Doomsday, Mystique is back in her classic white regalia, with long sleeves, pants, and a small tiara.

In a bigger reveal, it looks like Nightcrawler’s dual cutlasses are back in play, with a mannequin holding one blade in each hand. The outfit includes a long coat with the X logo emblazoned on its front, a waistcoat, pinstriped pants, and a turtleneck.

Other costumes included the Red Guardian's loud tracksuit, which he showed off at the end of the Thunderbolts movie, as well as Sentry’s (sorry, Bob’s) bathrobe from the film. Shuri’s Black Panther suit and Captain America’s classic costume were also placed in this group.

Given what we know so far, it’s easy to speculate that the events of Doomsday could take place just after the ending of Thunderbolts, given that’s when the Red Guardian showed off his shiny new tracksuit. For now, things are still being kept close to the chest by Marvel as fans await more information at tonight’s presentation in the Honda Center.

This is the latest news to come from D23 after Marvel updated the Avengers: Doomsday Clock Countdown stream on its official YouTube channel, inserting a new poster of Dr. Doom as well as a voiceover from Sue Storm. That same voiceover was heard in a trailer shown exclusively at Marvel’s Hall H Panel at San Diego Comic-Con, leaving fans even more curious to see what’ll get revealed next.

For more information about the movie and what’s next for the X-Men, keep it locked to IGN, or watch some of our interviews with the Doomsday cast, who shed a little light on what some of the teasers we’ve already seen could mean.

items.title: The Mandalorian and Grogu Lands Disney+ Release Date After Underperforming in Theaters With $345 Million
items.description: Disney has revealed a September release date for Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu on Disney+ after the movie underperformed in theaters with $345 million worldwide.
items.author: Michael Cripe
items.content:
Disney has revealed a September release date for Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu on Disney+ after the movie underperformed in theaters with $345 million worldwide.

The Mickey Mouse company announced the streaming update today, confirming plans to bring its latest spinoff film to the service starting September 2. Although Pedro Pascal and his little green friend didn't bring in groundbreaking numbers when The Mandalorian and Grogu premiered May 22, 2026, their new streaming home should give it a second chance to click with audiences.

Of course, there would be no movie without the Disney+ show it's based on. The Mandalorian helped kickstart Disney's service when it launched all the way back in 2019, and while the Baby Yoda phenomenon helped it land three seasons of TV, that success didn't carry over to the movie.

The Mandalorian and Grogu seemed due for soft returns when it debuted with one of the worst opening weekends for a Star Wars movie, with $165 million globally. With a reported budget of $165 million, it's hard to call it a failure, but the weeks that followed still showed viewers weren't too interested in finding their way to theaters for Pascal's Din Djarin. Its second weekend alone saw it slammed with a 69% drop.

The Mandalorian and Grogu ended its box office run with $345 million globally (via Box Office Mojo). It followed its time in theaters with a streaming release date in July, and now, it'll finally be available alongside its TV show counterparts on Disney+.

Disney said The Mandalorian and Grogu – as well as last month's live-action Moana remake – "underperformed" at the box office when going over its financial results recently. Although the Star Wars movie didn't make as much as it was expecting in raw ticket sales, the company said merchandise sales helped make up for the disappointment.

IGN called The Mandalorian and Grogu "Mediocre" in our 5/10 review. We said at the time, "If you’re looking for a Star Wars movie that thrills, surprises, challenges, or demonstrates a vested interest in seeing its characters grow and change… The Mandalorian and Grogu is not the way."

You can see how The Mandalorian movie compares to the rest of the Star Wars catalog when it comes to Disney+ in just a few weeks. Until then, you can read about one scene featuring Jeremy Allen White's Rotta the Hutt that was inspired by an iconic moment from the franchise's past.

items.title: As Avengers: Doomsday Tickets Go on Sale, Marvel Releases New Poster and Makes an Interesting Change to the YouTube Countdown
items.description: The Avengers: Doomsday countdown that’s been streaming on Marvel’s official YouTube channel since January 13, 2026 underwent a subtle change on August 14 that ties back to its Hall H panel from San Diego Comic Con this year.
items.author: Virginia Glaze
items.content:
The Avengers: Doomsday countdown that’s been streaming on Marvel’s official YouTube channel since January 13, 2026 underwent a subtle change on August 14 that ties back to its Hall H panel from San Diego Comic Con this year.

D23 is underway, with its highly-anticipated Honda Center presentations set to take place tonight, August 14. To celebrate, tickets for Avengers: Doomsday are now on sale everywhere, available at Fandango or wherever tickets are sold, expanding from the advance ticket sales previously only available for INFINITY VISION-certified Premium Large Format theaters.

That’s not the only big news for Doomsday; a new poster was also released today, showing Victor Von Doom clenching his fist in a villainous pose, with a bright light shining through a stained-glass window just behind him.

Of course, the most buzzed-about news from Marvel this morning involves the Avengers: Doomsday Clock countdown stream on its YouTube channel. Along with slotting in the new Dr. Doom poster, it also features a voiceover from Sue Storm, who says: “Victor was always the smartest guy in every room. He used to be different.”

Eagle-eyed viewers will have noticed that this is the same voiceover that was featured in Marvel’s Hall H Panel trailer at San Diego Comic Con this year. That trailer featured “intense shots” of Thor, Shang-Chi, Shuri, and Gambit, as well as Doom raising his hand to raise an army of dormant Sentinels from the ground in one of the most comic accurate scenes we’ve seen in a movie thus far.

While a fan’s recording of the trailer leaked on social media shortly thereafter, it was quickly scrubbed from the internet. For now, fans will have to wait for tonight’s D23 presentations for more information, though there have been a few displays on the Anaheim Convention Center floor showing off costumes from the film.

One of the most significant of these is Dr. Doom’s second armor in the movie, which includes his signature metal mask, green cloak, and a military-style outfit. Also spotted on the floor were costumes for Nightcrawler and Mystique, both characters confirmed to be in Doomsday.

For now, keep it locked to IGN for more news from D23 as it arises, and check out our interviews with the cast from San Diego Comic Con.

For now, keep it locked to IGN for more news from D23 as it arises, and check out our interviews with the cast from San Diego Comic Con.
